---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement or discuss a payment failure case
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem or workflow

Who needs this, and what are they trying to do?

## Proposed behavior

Describe inputs, expected results and how this fits the existing policy/approval/idempotency boundaries.

## Alternatives and tradeoffs

What can users do today? Which failure cases should an implementation cover?

## Scope and evidence

- Is this test-only, simulated or a verified sandbox capability?
- Link official provider/SDK documentation when applicable.
- Does this affect existing tools/routes, accounting or persistent state?

Do not include credentials, private account details, ntfy topics or approval links.
